base: pure-oreb-turnover-time-1 unchanged; pure cards; no new calibration
scope: single mechanism implementation and deterministic rule/parity/integration tests; no production no-rim rate estimation, season accuracy claims or baseline promotion
switch: rimContactClock; default false; enabled requires explicit per-missed-shot boolean resolver; unknown is rejected, never silently becomes no-rim

rule.offensiveFGRebound: rim contact =>140 deciseconds; no contact=>carry remaining deciseconds; applies player and team retained possession
rule.expiredNoRim: if clock expires during no-rim flight before period end, stop at expiry and record natural dead clockTov without awarding an individual rebound; period expiry takes priority
rule.limitations: immediate and clear defensive-control exception at expiry not modeled; flight/contact/control intervals remain abstract; independent per-possession clock hazards unchanged

randomness: rim decision gets dedicated seed-xor RNG; no added draws in gameplay/time/rebound RNG streams. All-rim resolver must reproduce baseline gameplay exactly. No block=>no-rim assumption.

tests.unit: positive and zero remaining time; player/team retain; FT; period end; invalid contact; independent RNG and no missing resolver
tests.integration: four seasons first12 schedule fixtures seed20261012; baseline vs switchOff vs enabled allRim (exact score/team/player/gameplay events after dropping newly added telemetry); forced allNoRim stress only, no inference to real frequency
tests.stress: allNoRim is intentionally unrealistic branch coverage, not a prediction or an adoption candidate

protected: all prior protected manifests and prior two deliverable manifests; src/scripts and package files snapshot before implementation
stop: report rules/parity/stress and limitations; no other engine fixes
